paper.title: Machine-Learning Accelerated Computational Spectroscopy Reveals Vibrational Signature of the Oxidation Level of Graphene in Contact with Water

graphene-water.description: two pristine graphene planes (288 C each) sandwiching the water slab

construction_model.derivation: Water-slab thickness is derived from water count, target density, and xy cell area. For graphene/GO systems, two 288-C basal planes are placed symmetrically outside the centered water slab with the declared oxygen clearance. No published coordinate is used.

scope_note: Exactly these five systems are scored. The binding topology and construction rules are in construction_model: two parallel graphene/GO basal planes (288 C each) sandwich a centered ~1.0 g/cm3 water slab with vacuum at both z edges; this is not stacked graphite. Composition totals, cells, water and functional-group counts are binding; in-plane registration is constructor freedom. The author training dataset uses smaller interface boxes (C72-144); cross-size generalization is part of the DP-MP capability under test.
